messages:
hana (Billing): Heads up — BetaHealth flagged that they received TWO invoices for March: INV-2026-03-BH and INV-2026-03-BH-dup. One includes tax lines, the other doesn't. Both are showing as due.
luis (Customer Success): They attached screenshots and say AP already paid the one with tax. Now accounting is confused and paused POs. Can we confirm which is correct?
billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_1812 | status: completed. created: INV-2026-03-BH
billing-bot: invoice-generator | job_2026_03_1815 | status: completed. created: INV-2026-03-BH-dup
hana (Billing): Two jobs within 3 minutes — suspicious. Was there a retry that should have been idempotent?
devon (Platform): Looking at the webhook logs — usage-aggregator POSTed twice because the first ack timed out at the caller and retried. Our idempotency key is usage_run_id; the first payload arrived with usage_run_id:null due to a parsing error so it bypassed idempotency. Second payload had proper id.
tom (Finance): Do the invoices differ in amounts or line items? Which one has the payment?
hana (Billing): Quick diff:
- Both have subscription: 15000, overage_embeddings: 1200, support: 300
- INV-2026-03-BH shows tax_state=CA, tax_amount=1146
- INV-2026-03-BH-dup has tax_amount=0 and tax_state missing
kevin (Payments): Payment logs show a txn tied to INV-2026-03-BH. The duplicate shows no payment. So the paid invoice is INV-2026-03-BH.
luis (Customer Success): BetaHealth says they paid the taxed invoice and want the duplicate voided and a confirmation note.
devon (Platform): Root cause: the first payload lost tax_region and usage_run_id due to a CSV->JSON parsing edge case. That caused a second job to generate a second invoice missing tax metadata. I'll patch the parser and add validation to reject jobs without usage_run_id.
tom (Finance): Action items: void the duplicate, attach a void confirmation to the ticket, and add a ledger reversal entry so AR doesn't include the duplicate. Also add a postmortem if more than one duplicate in 48h.
hana (Billing): Doing the void now. billing-bot: invoice-manager | INV-2026-03-BH-dup | set_status: cancelled | reason: duplicate_of_INV-2026-03-BH
billing-bot: ledger | create_reversal | invoice:INV-2026-03-BH-dup | amount:0.00 | note: voided duplicate
kevin (Payments): Confirmed no refunds required. Payment remains applied to INV-2026-03-BH. I'll update reconciliations and note to AR to ignore the dup.
luis (Customer Success): Sent customer the void confirmation email and screenshot. They acknowledged and thanked us for the quick handling.
devon (Platform): PR opened: fix/usage-parser-null-runid #487. Also adding alert: more than 1 invoice for same account within 5m should page infra.
tom (Finance): Please also add a QA check to the invoice pipeline that fails generation if tax_region is missing for taxable accounts.
hana (Billing): Filed follow-up ticket for finance-ops: add unit tests for idempotency and tax-region validation. Scanning last 48h for possible duplicates now.
luis (Customer Success): Customer happy. Closing loop once retro is posted.
tom (Finance): Thanks all. Attach cancelled PDF and reversal note to the support ticket and mark this resolved once scan completes. :thumbsup:
